title: Things We Have That Future Generations Won't (demo outro)
note: Synthetic outro modelled on a real video: the sponsor segment starts with the Open Sauce anecdote, minutes before Boot.dev is named.

cues.text: and that is really the thing about zinc it is everywhere and nobody thinks about it until it is gone
so in general we are looking at a world that is a lot more regional and a lot less global
a lot more communal and less consumerist which honestly does not sound that bad
am I an optimist not really because I do think all of that follows a pretty massive collapse
the future is of course unwritten but whatever direction it goes it will be weirder than we expect
so chime in below how bad do you think it gets before we stabilize ourselves
which resources that I did not mention do you want to bring up this should be a fun comment section
so a couple months back I went to Open Sauce in San Francisco
if you are not familiar with it it is kind of like a creator convention but it focuses on makers and builders
people making robots cool new tech big nerd stuff
and probably no surprise but I met a lot of viewers of the channel there because you all are nerdy
like here is how nerdy this convention is I saw three separate people wearing shirts with regular expressions on them
and a bunch of you told me the same thing that you always wanted to learn to code and never got around to it
and I get that because every course starts with hello world and then dumps a textbook on you
which is why I was glad to finally try the sponsor of this outro because it does not do that
thanks to boot.dev for supporting this video boot.dev is a platform that teaches back end development by making you build things
you learn Python and Go by writing actual projects with a story running through it and it is honestly kind of addictive
they are offering you nerds twenty five percent off your entire first year on an annual plan
if you click the link down below or just scan the QR code here on screen
actually I bet you could learn how to program QR codes through this
thank you guys so much for watching now you go out there and have an eye opening rest of the week
stay safe and I will see you next Monday love you guys take care
